attributes.action: Bank Holiday on Monday 6th July 2026 for England game at 1am.
attributes.additional_details: We want to be able to watch and support England on Monday 6th July 2026 for their World Cup game at 1am.
attributes.background: England have gone through to the last 16 and the game is on at 1am, no one will be able to watch the game who work a 9-5. Scotland was given a Bank Holiday for their game at 1am why can’t England receive the same.

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, this date had already passed.
